title: Montymi Template
summary: Customize a coastal design system in your browser, preserve your configuration in a GitHub fork, and deploy a website you own.
description: A Next.js starter connecting live visual customization with repository ownership. It includes coordinated palette presets, token import and export, generated brand assets, localized pages, PWA support, and a guided GitHub-to-Vercel workflow.
role: Product direction and AI-assisted full-stack development
features: Live design-token editing with light and dark themes
Validated token JSON import and export
Logo and avatar previews with generated web app assets
Browser-saved snapshots retained through GitHub sign-in
Saved configurations committed atomically into a new GitHub fork
